title: NASA wants four people to pretend to live on Mars

vocab.meaning: To simulate something is to copy it so it feels real, but it is only practice. You can do it to learn how something works. In the article, NASA will simulate a trip to Mars here on Earth.
examples: We simulate a fire drill at school so we know how to get out safely.
My brother used a toy kitchen to simulate cooking dinner.

vocab.meaning: A participant is a person who takes part in something. They join in and do the activity. In the article, the participants are the four people who will live in the practice Mars home.
examples: Every participant in the race got a ribbon.
I was a participant in the school play.

vocab.articleQuote: The other is modeled after a Mars habitat.
vocab.meaning: A habitat is a place where someone or something lives. It gives them what they need, like air, food, and shelter. In the article, a Mars habitat is a building where people could live on Mars.
examples: A pond is a habitat for frogs and ducks.
The zoo built a new habitat with trees and a pool for the otters.

quiz.question: What is NASA looking for?
options: Four people to join a pretend trip to Mars
Four dogs to go to space
quiz.explanation: NASA wants four participants for a yearlong practice mission.

quiz.question: How long will the practice mission last?
quiz.explanation: The four people will live in the practice homes for a year.

quiz.question: Where will the people really be during the mission?
options: On a ship in the ocean
At the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas
quiz.explanation: They will not go to space. They will live in special buildings in Texas.

quiz.question: What does "simulate" mean?
options: To copy something so it feels real, as practice
quiz.explanation: To simulate is to copy something as practice. NASA will simulate a Mars trip on Earth.

quiz.question: Why is the practice mission a good idea?
options: It helps NASA learn what astronauts might face, in a safe way
quiz.explanation: No one has been to Mars, so the practice mission is a safe test run.
